mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 0.25% over three months signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises above 0.25% and remains there for 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 70% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) of more than 2% signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -2%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 60% of triggered months.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in industrial production (INDPRO) of more than 1% over three consecutive months indicates contraction in manufacturing output, which depresses earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls for 3 consecutive months by >1%
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL above their respective 12-month moving averages signals a dual shock of higher rates and inflation, which erodes real corporate earnings and triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 60% of dual-shock episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A strong positive correlation between HOUST and GDPC1 over the past six months indicates robust housing demand coinciding with overall demand growth, which boosts consumer confidence and supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: Pearson correlation(HOST, GDPC1) > 0.7 over last 6 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +1%) in at least 60% of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in PAYEMS above 0.5% signals robust job creation, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days in any macro regime.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +1%) in at least 60% of triggered months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in INDPRO above its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months signals a manufacturing recovery, which increases earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +1%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.
